patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Ocean.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose BookYourData only if your buying job matches “Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go cre” rather than Ocean.io's shape. Choose Ocean.io only if your buying job matches “Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/cr” rather than BookYourData's shape. Workflow advantage: BookYourData leans email-outreach; Ocean.io leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Ocean.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: BookYourData is Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go credits and a 97% deliverability guarantee.; Ocean.io is Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/credit, ~$47/mo yearly headline..
- Workflow coverage skew: BookYourData-leaning email-outreach vs Ocean.io-leaning data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: BookYourData — none listed; Ocean.io — Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer.

Limitations — BookYourData: —; Ocean.io: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Credit minimums and yearly packaging require modeling before comparing to seat tools.
